description.zh: 旧版应用配置（JSON格式），目前已废弃
description.en: The application configurations in the JSON format. This parameter is deprecated.

description.zh: 是否第二天重启应用，true：重启，false：不重启。
description.en: Specifies whether to restart the application the next day. Valid values: true and false.

description.zh: 后端应用部署区域（端到端链路场景使用）
description.en: The region where the backend application is deployed. This parameter is used in end-to-end tracing scenarios.

description.zh: 设置移动端SDK采集配置，支持按APP版本开启或关闭采集项
description.en: The collection configurations of the mobile SDK. You can enable or disable collection configurations based on the app version.
Specifies whether you want to subscribe to the application. Valid values: true and false.

description.zh: 应用实际接入Region（仅上海金融云场景使用）
description.en: The region where the application resides. You can leave this parameter empty or set it to China East 2 Finance.

description.zh: 是否重启应用，true：重启，false：不重启。
description.en: Specifies whether to restart the application. Valid values: true and false.

description.zh: 设置应用服务域名，支持创建、修改、删除服务域名配置
description.en: The service domain name of the application. You can create, modify, and delete service domain name configurations.

description.zh: 是否停止应用，true：停止，false：不停止。
description.en: Specifies whether to stop the application. Valid values: true and false.
